title: Wash before using
text: Wash before using. I absolutely love satin bed sheets, comfortable, cool, soft, the list goes on…I will always use them, I will never go back to cotton. BUT beware these satin bed sheets have formaldehyde resin on them, leaving me covered in hives head to toe, and my hair started thinning and falling out. Just soak them in baking soda to neutralize the formaldehyde for 8 hours and wash as directed before using them so you don’t end up like me.
